column1: # Generic tooling catalogue. felix new filters this by what it detects in a
# checkout, so a project starts with rows that already apply to it.
# Nothing language-specific lives here. A row that only makes sense for one
# ecosystem belongs in that project's stack.tsv, not in everyone's default.
# semgrep is risk=high despite being a security tool, and the reason is the
# rule rather than the vendor: it ships five hooks and an MCP server, all of
# which run a precompiled binary on every Write, Edit and Bash. That is real
# code executing on your machine every session, and "ships hooks" is high by
# this catalogue's own standard whoever wrote them. Felix recommends it loudly
# and refuses to mount it unattended. A person installs this one.
# The sixth column is free-text keywords, used only by felix recommend --want.
